correctness.rationale: Cube-orthogonal radial (3), standard (two copies of n-1), and harmonic quadratic (n(n-3)/2) subspaces exhaust the coefficient dimension. Radial and standard shell blocks are rank-one outer products with explicit traces and determinants. Two unequal layer sums make both rank-two; harmonic scalar 1-2 rho2+rho4 is strictly positive at every interior layer. Hence exactly one zero eigenvalue and precisely the listed positive roots/scalar. Independent exact-rational matrix actions and combinatorial 4th moments were checked for dimensions 5–9, and seven central specializations.

originality.rationale: The closest related indexed and literature results concern a single Hamming shell, a Hamming ball, other concentration domains, or equally weighted antipodal shell pairs. The latter is subsumed but does not imply arbitrary non-antipodal means and unequal mixture weights; the two rank-one summands generally fail to share eigenvectors. No equivalent complete two-layer formula was found after comparing content and hypotheses, though a more general representation-theoretic formula may exist elsewhere.

value.rationale: Two stratified interior Hamming layers are a natural minimal observation family for quadratic Walsh reconstruction. The theorem supplies a complete all-dimension, all-layer, all-positive-weight rank classification and sharp spectral stability on the identifiable quotient, including asymmetric noncommuting Gram sectors, rather than arbitrary finite numerics or a relabeling of the antipodal specialization.
